articles.body: Are you allowed to hire local alliances during the Events in India phase or do you need to hire them during a Commander's turn in order to keep officers and regiments in reserve for threatening Events in India that come later?
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>Are you allowed to hire local alliances during the Events in India phase or do you need to hire them during a Commander's turn in order to keep officers and regiments in reserve for threatening Events in India that come later?</safehtml></xml>

articles.body:
[q="descoga"]Are you allowed to hire local alliances during the Events in India phase or do you need to hire them during a Commander's turn in order to keep officers and regiments in reserve for threatening Events in India that come later?[/q]

They can only be hired during the relevant Commander's turn.

<?xml version="1.0"?>

articles.body:
[q="brokengod"][q="descoga"]Are you allowed to hire local alliances during the Events in India phase or do you need to hire them during a Commander's turn in order to keep officers and regiments in reserve for threatening Events in India that come later?[/q]

They can only be hired during the relevant Commander's turn.[/q]
To add on to this, they can only be purchased at the beginning of that Commanders turn, before the Commander makes any deployments.

articles.body:
And to make it crystal clear, yes, you can use local alliances that you hired at the beginning of a commander’s turn to defend during events in India (it is explicitly mentioned in the rule book). The clean-up phase, when local alliances return to the supply, comes after the events in India phase, so you can use them, if you wish.

Generally, the recommendation is to use local alliances on the offense. The reason is that you will get a guaranteed benefit for the money you spent, i.e. a bigger dice pool. Meanwhile, if you use local alliances for defence, you might not really need them, and they usually cost more per troop strength (the cheapest is £1.5/strength), so it costs less to maintain your own garrison (always £1/strength).
